_comment: Godot-only content: the guided first day (steps shown one at a time by Odessa's guide card) and one-time tip cards. {action} is replaced by the player's current key for that action; {move} by the four movement keys. done: moved | looked | flag:X | panel:X | buildmode | accepted:Q | ready:Q | quest:Q | objective:Q:index | stage:Q:N (request Q has reached its Nth stage, counting from 0). reveal: HUD parts that appear from this step on.

steps.text: Walk with {move}. Odessa is waving at the village gate. Go and say hello!
Look around: drag with the right mouse button, or press {cam_left} / {cam_right}. Scroll to zoom.
Walk up to Odessa and press {interact} to talk.
Find a tree with a pink ribbon (the compass points to the nearest) and press {interact} to chop. Press {interact} again when the needle is in the green.
Press {inventory} to open your bag and see what you gathered.
Catch a floating magic fragment: just walk through one. They sparkle purple.
Go back to Odessa and press {interact} to show her.
Press {journal} to open your journal. Every request you take on is kept there.
Fern wants a bridge to the orchard. Find her by the river and press {interact}.
Fern needs 10 more wood and 8 Spark Energy for the bridge. Chop ribbon trees and catch fragments; the request card in the corner counts for you.
You have the materials! Walk to the river and press {build} to use the Starforge Tool.
Lay planks from bank to bank. A plank must be within 2 tiles of a bank or a post.
Fern asked for railings: place 4 along the sides of the bridge. A railing sits on a tile's edge; {rotate} turns it.
Tell Fern her bridge is ready!

talk.title: Talking
lines: Click an answer, or press its number.
Gold answers start a request.
Esc says goodbye.

chop.title: Chopping
lines: Press {interact} when the needle is in the green. Gold is a perfect swing.
Three swings fell the tree. It grows back after a while.

mine.title: Mining
lines: Press {interact} when the dark ring lines up with the green circle.
Glowing rocks hide crystals.

fish.title: Fishing
lines: Wait for the bobber to dip, then press {interact}.
Keep the fish inside the green bar to reel it in.

build.title: Starforge building
lines: Pick a piece at the bottom, then click to place it. {rotate} turns it.
Green means it fits; red tells you why it doesn't.
Click a placed piece to move, recolour or remove it. Ctrl+Z undoes. Esc leaves.

harmony.title: Kingdom Harmony
lines: Helping villagers and building things raise Harmony.
New blueprints, places and surprises unlock as it grows. Press {progress} to see what's next.

journal.title: Your journal
lines: Active requests, finished ones, and what's still to do.
Track a request to point the compass at it.

map.title: The world map
lines: Hearthglow is the first of five isles.
The others open as the story goes on.

requests.title: More villagers need you
lines: An orange ! above someone means they have a request. A green ★ means a request is ready to hand in.
Take them in any order. There's no rush.
